mapper.sql: mr.id, mr.merchant_row_id, mr.merchant_owner_member_id, mr.registration_id, mr.redemption_id, mr.author_member_id, mr.rating, mr.content, mr.images_json, mr.status, mr.reply_content, mr.reply_actor_member_id, mr.reply_actor_role_code, mr.reply_request_id, mr.reply_fingerprint, mr.replied_at, mr.create_request_id, mr.create_fingerprint, mr.moderation_reason, mr.moderated_at, mr.version, mr.create_time, mr.update_time
mapper.select: select id from ums_member where id = #{memberId} and status = 1 and del_flag = 0 for update

select count(1) from mms_merchant target join mms_merchant sibling on sibling.member_id = target.member_id and sibling.status = 1 and sibling.account_status = 1 and sibling.del_flag = 0 where target.id = #{merchantRowId} and target.status = 1 and target.account_status = 1 and target.del_flag = 0

select mm.id as merchant_row_id, mm.member_id as merchant_owner_member_id, r.id as registration_id, rd.id as redemption_id from redemption rd straight_join cms_registration r on r.id = rd.registration_id and r.member_id = #{authorMemberId} straight_join mms_merchant mm on mm.id = #{merchantRowId} and mm.member_id = rd.merchant_id and mm.status = 1 and mm.account_status = 1 and mm.del_flag = 0 where rd.registration_id = #{registrationId} and rd.status = 'ACTIVE' and not exists ( select 1 from mms_merchant sibling where sibling.member_id = mm.member_id and sibling.status = 1 and sibling.account_status = 1 and sibling.del_flag = 0 and sibling.id <> mm.id ) order by rd.create_time desc, rd.id desc limit 1 for update

select mm.id as merchant_row_id, mm.member_id as merchant_owner_member_id, r.id as registration_id, rd.id as redemption_id from cms_registration r join redemption rd on rd.registration_id = r.id and rd.status = 'ACTIVE' join mms_merchant mm on mm.id = #{merchantRowId} and mm.member_id = rd.merchant_id and mm.status = 1 and mm.account_status = 1 and mm.del_flag = 0 where r.member_id = #{authorMemberId} and not exists ( select 1 from mms_merchant sibling where sibling.member_id = mm.member_id and sibling.status = 1 and sibling.account_status = 1 and sibling.del_flag = 0 and sibling.id <> mm.id ) and not exists ( select 1 from merchant_review used where used.registration_id = r.id and used.merchant_owner_member_id = mm.member_id ) order by rd.create_time desc, rd.id desc limit 1

select mm.id as merchant_row_id, mm.member_id as merchant_owner_member_id, r.id as registration_id, rd.id as redemption_id from cms_registration r join redemption rd on rd.registration_id = r.id and rd.status = 'ACTIVE' join mms_merchant mm on mm.id = #{merchantRowId} and mm.member_id = rd.merchant_id and mm.status = 1 and mm.account_status = 1 and mm.del_flag = 0 where r.member_id = #{authorMemberId} and r.id = #{registrationId} and not exists ( select 1 from mms_merchant sibling where sibling.member_id = mm.member_id and sibling.status = 1 and sibling.account_status = 1 and sibling.del_flag = 0 and sibling.id <> mm.id ) and not exists ( select 1 from merchant_review used where used.registration_id = r.id and used.merchant_owner_member_id = mm.member_id ) order by rd.create_time desc, rd.id desc limit 1
select from merchant_review mr where mr.id = #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_review (merchant_row_id, merchant_owner_member_id, registration_id, redemption_id, author_member_id, rating, content, images_json, status, create_request_id, create_fingerprint, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{merchantRowId}, #{merchantOwnerMemberId}, #{registrationId}, #{redemptionId}, #{authorMemberId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{imagesJson}, #{status}, #{createRequestId}, #{createFingerprint}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select count(1) from merchant_review mr where mr.merchant_row_id = #{merchantRowId} and mr.status = 'VISIBLE'

select , u.nickname as author_nickname, u.avatar as author_avatar from merchant_review mr left join ums_member u on u.id = mr.author_member_id where mr.merchant_row_id = #{merchantRowId} and mr.status = 'VISIBLE' order by mr.create_time desc, mr.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(1) as reviewCount, round(avg(mr.rating), 1) as averageRating from merchant_review mr where mr.merchant_row_id = #{merchantRowId} and mr.status = 'VISIBLE'
select max(coalesce(mr.update_time, mr.create_time)) from merchant_review mr where mr.merchant_row_id = #{merchantRowId} and mr.status = 'VISIBLE'

select coalesce(sum(case when mr.status = 'VISIBLE' and mr.reply_content is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pendingReplyCount, coalesce(sum(case when mr.create_time >= date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') and mr.create_time < date_add(date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01'), interval 1 month) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as monthNewCount, case when coalesce(sum(case when mr.status = 'VISIBLE' then 1 else 0 end), 0) = 0 then 0 else round( coalesce(sum(case when mr.status = 'VISIBLE' and mr.reply_content is not null then 1 else 0 end), 0) * 100 / sum(case when mr.status = 'VISIBLE' then 1 else 0 end), 0 ) end as replyRatePct from merchant_review mr where mr.merchant_row_id = #{merchantRowId}
mapper.sql: (mr.status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' or exists ( select 1 from merchant_review_report rr join audit_task pr_task on pr_task.id = rr.audit_task_id where rr.review_id = mr.id and rr.merchant_row_id = mr.merchant_row_id and pr_task.status in (0, 3) ))

choose.when: and mr.status = 'VISIBLE' and mr.reply_content is null
and mr.images_json is not null and mr.images_json not in ('', '[]')

mapper.select:
select , u.nickname as author_nickname, u.avatar as author_avatar, case when then 1 else 0 end as under_platform_review from merchant_review mr left join ums_member u on u.id = mr.author_member_id where mr.merchant_row_id = #{merchantRowId}
order by mr.create_time desc, mr.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select count(1) as all_count, coalesce(sum(case when mr.status = 'VISIBLE' and mr.reply_content is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pending_count, coalesce(sum(case when mr.rating <= 3 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as low_count, coalesce(sum(case when mr.images_json is not null and mr.images_json not in ('', '[]') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as photo_count, coalesce(sum(case when then 1 else 0 end), 0) as platform_count from merchant_review mr where mr.merchant_row_id = #{merchantRowId}
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_review_report (review_id, merchant_row_id, merchant_owner_member_id, reporter_member_id, reporter_role_code, reason_text, request_id, request_fingerprint, audit_task_id, create_time) values (#{reviewId}, #{merchantRowId}, #{merchantOwnerMemberId}, #{reporterMemberId}, #{reporterRoleCode}, #{reasonText}, #{requestId}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{auditTaskId}, #{createTime})
